hook: Clear the fur without the waste.
caption:
#ad Furniture seems to attract pet hair like a magnet. This simple roller lifts fur off couches and clothes without using any sticky refill sheets. Just roll it back and forth, empty the built-in chamber, and get right back to relaxing.

Find more on the shelf: https://solvix-shelf.pages.dev/

brief: Pet hair roller: a reusable roller that lifts fur off sofas and clothes, with no sticky sheets to refill
